They came across extreme weather, states of emergency, evacuations, challenging budgets as well as life-changing encounters, incredible acts of generosity and dramatic landscapes. Most of all, they had to survive each other.

programme.title: Journey Within S01 E01 - Costa Rica - JGO
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore Zunya, an eco-village, and its enchanting blue zone concept. We delve into communal living, uncovering its allure. At La Senda, we experience soul cleansing Temazcal and a sublime cacao ceremony. We engage in a farm-to-table activity, savouring locally sourced ingredients. Cala Luna offers a rejuvenating body treatment amidst serene surroundings. We encounter the Maleku Tribes, witnessing their dance ceremony and visiting their cacao farm. The journey concludes with a breath taking hike and a majestic volcano view, reminding us of nature's beauty. This episode is a transformative adventure of self-discovery, cultural immersion, and connection with nature.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape S01 E01 - India Part 1
programme.desc: Gordon’s odyssey begins in the north, home of our curry house classics. On board an express train he’s thrown in at the deep end and experiences a back-to-basics baptism of fire, cooking for its many passengers in the train’s cramped pantry car and getting travel sick while he’s making curry. In stark contrast he then meets his match working for a cantankerous royal chef, preparing a biryani with a difference for a huge wedding feast before venturing into the jungle where he gets eaten alive by ants when he scales a 40-foot tree in search of the local tribe’s favourite delicacy. Then it’s on to Delhi to cook at the restaurant that invented tandoori chicken, where Gordon puts into practice everything he’s learnt for a tough crowd of Delhi food critics.

programme.title: The 1950's Boom and Rock
programme.desc: In the 1950's, every teenager had a transistor radio and went to the sock hop. Designer and sewing expert Gretchen Hirsch shows how to make an updated circle skirt for today. Lisa Shaw adds contemporary machine-embroidery to a cardigan sweater, inspired by the sweaters of the 1950's. Gretchen returns to show how to add a gathered crinoline to make the skirt really full and flirty.

programme.title: Stacked Increases + FOX PAWS Knitting Pattern
programme.desc: Having trouble with your Fox Paws scarf? Well, you're not the only one! Luckily, designer Xandy is here to share her tips and tricks for navigating her famously intricate pattern.

programme.title: Four Ways to Yarn Over in Pattern & Lace Knitting Demystified
programme.desc: Did you know there is more than one way to do a yarn over? Yup, there are actually four! This week Tracey and Jodi demonstrate all four techniques and talk about when to use each.

programme.title: Lines
programme.desc: A line is an infinitely extending one-dimensional figure; one that has length but not width or thickness. In art lines are the basis that give form to a piece of art. They can be straight or curved, thick or thin, and raised or flat. Projects featuring lines: a modern art canvas with paint and masking tape; lines become three dimensional as we make a playhouse for dolls or action figures; continue with your art journal and use brightly colored pens and a special tool to make spirograph line drawings. Finally make an unbreakable stained glass plaque with foil.

programme.title: Stylish
programme.desc: Freshen up your style statement. Jenny Barnett-Rohrs fashions a colorful ID bracelet from clay and makes a foxy felt animal pouch. Jenny weaves a trendy beaded bracelet of silver and gold. Then, using fabric and ribbon, Jenny creates a decorator-style memo board to stay organized.

programme.title: Color and Creativity
programme.desc: Keep creativity flowing with inspiration from colors. On-line jewelry-making host and crafter Vicki O'Dell makes quick, thoughtful, colorful gifts for everyone. Katie sets crystals into a cup chain cuff and bangle, then adds knotted leather accents for a one-of-a-kind look.

programme.title: Unconventional Art
programme.desc: Artists are known for taking an unconventional approach to their art – often introducing "non art" supplies to their work. First we look at stamped metal for inventive beads. Then Candie Cooper throws a curve and uses cookie tins for her project. Next Kate Richbourg throws out the loom for a lalique bracelet that is loom free. We'll finish up with artist Tammy Honaman as she manipulates right angle weave to turn it into shapes and beads.

programme.title: Occasional Table
programme.desc: George Vondriska shows you how to make an occasional table to provide a convenient place for drinks, TV remotes, or a decorative lamp. He demonstrates the unique process of ebonizing, an alternative to stain used to give wood a rich, dark finish. With attractive tapered legs and a ceramic tabletop, this table is a great project to advance your woodworking skills.

programme.title: Creative Crochet Corner presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Creative Crochet Corner is an online video streaming service all about learning how to crochet! Whether you're a new to crochet just learning the basics or an experienced crocheter looking for a challenge, Creative Crochet Corner is here to help. We offer a vast library of video tutorials taught by talented crochet experts who guide you through each technique step-by-step, sharing their best tips and tricks.

programme.title: Blocks
programme.desc: The first episode of Fresh Quilting's new season features blocks - the most basic of quilt techniques. Ebony Love show how to use negative space in nontraditional blocks. Then, Lee Chappell Monroe demonstrates basic techniques for attaching blocks together. Eliane Bergmann will close each episode with a sewing machine tip to elevate your quilting. Her tip for this episode is quilt as you go and how to create panels with scraps and turn them into coasters, pouches and more.

programme.title: Weave it Be
programme.desc: This week's woven lattice quilt might look intricate, but it's actually perfect for beginners!

programme.title: Milky Way
programme.desc: The Walters household is eating healthy this week, but that doesn't mean Angela's quilts have to be. Today she is whipping up the Milky Way Quilt by Monique Dillard featuring Lily & Loom fabric.

programme.title: Movie Stars
programme.desc: Inspiration for today's fashion comes from many sources, including the glamour of the silver screen. Angela Wolf starts out with a luxurious chemise top; perfect under a jacket or sweater or glamorous all by itself for evening wear. Then it's time to bring out your inner princess as Cheryl Sleboda creates crowns - fit for a movie star, your favorite cosplay outfit, or a little girl's party.

programme.title: Trendspotting: Parachute Cord and Flowers
programme.desc: Using parachute cord in a whole new way, author Ashley Bunting adds beads from her stash to make a charming, colorful floral brooch. Katie rides the floral jewelry wave with pendants made with leather flowers, wire and crystals.

programme.title: Episode 2: Pocket Scrapbooking
programme.desc: Save special treasures in pockets. Julie Fei-Fan Balzer brushes up page pockets with patterns. May Flaum mixes pockets into traditional pages. Joe Rotella has a stamping tip and Christine Drumheller goes way outside the pockets with embellishments.

programme.title: Inspiration
programme.desc: This season is all about inspiration, particularly from the art masters. We're not only inspired but we take that creativity one step further with new materials. We begin with a design that pays homage to Sigmar Polke, a contemporary artist that was known for using varied materials even glass. We make a stitched canvas. Then Joe Rotella is back, taking a page from Sigmar's book by using found objects like wood and license plates to make a modern birdhouse. We'll finish up with May Flaum and the post-impressionist era and a lesson on being inspired by art but styling it in your own way.

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Or really, really needing to crunch into juicy fried chicken right now. Hosted by Charlotte Mei, the runner-up of Eat List Star, Crave finds out what gets celebrities salivating – roti prata, roast meats, sushi, satay, salted egg ice cream, buah keluak, and even an English-style big breakfast! Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it!

programme.title: Its In Our Nature
programme.desc: A million wildlife species are facing the threat of extinction. But why does this matter to a tiny city state like Singapore? What do we stand to lose if our wildlife go extinct? Host Lam Shushan comes face to face with some of the rarest creatures in the world and meets the tenacious frontliners who are racing to save our native wildlife from extinction.

programme.title: Vettai
programme.desc: "They are part of a special task force assembled to tackle cases pertaining to the Indian community and Indian immigrants. The unit is not widely publicized and their work is kept under wraps. Spearheaded by Chief Dayanidhi, the team consists of three teams and an assigned criminologist. Together they try to tackle cold blooded murders, kidnaps and sexual crimes. But as their professional and personal lives collide, the team is headed towards a perilous outcome. Lives will be lost and bonds will be broken. The pledge that they made to uphold justice and peace in the country that they love will be put to the test. How will they survive? Where does it all lead to? Who is the villain and who is the hero?"

programme.title: A Quiet Place To Kill
programme.desc: A disillusioned race-car driver plots to kill her ex-husband at the behest of his new wife, but the plan quickly goes awry.

programme.title: Algiers
programme.desc: A wanted jewel thief ensconced in the Casbah meets a beautiful woman who makes him long for an escape.

programme.title: The Phantom Of The Opera
programme.desc: A mad, disfigured composer seeks love with a lovely young opera singer.

programme.title: The Mark Of The Hawk
programme.desc: Obam finds himself caught in the middle of hostility between British colonists and African villagers who want to reclaim their land. He sets out to save his country before tensions get out of control.

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
programme.desc: An American doctor and his wife, a former singing star, witness a murder while vacationing in Morocco, and are drawn into a twisting plot of international intrigue when their young son is kidnapped.

programme.title: Submarine Base
programme.desc: WW2: US ganster-on-the-run Joe sells torpedoes to German U-boats on a remote island off South America. When shipwrecked engineer Jim is saved by Joe and arrives on the island a showdown seems inevitable.

programme.title: The Lady From Chungking
programme.desc: After the Japanese invade China in WW 2, a young woman leads a band of partisans against the occupying troops.

programme.title: Aerial Gunner
programme.desc: Old rivals are pitted against each other in basic training and fight over the same woman.

programme.title: Nosferatu : A Symphony of Horror
programme.desc: Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence and real estate agent Hutter's wife.

programme.title: Eagle in a Cage
programme.desc: In 1815, a soldier becomes the Governor of St. Helena, and jailer of Napoleon.

programme.title: The Steel Claw
programme.desc: A Marine stationed in the Philippines loses a hand in an accident and is discharged from the Corps. When the Japanese invade the Philippines, he is called back into service to rescue a general held by Filipino guerrillas behind Japanese lines.

programme.title: Outpost In Morocco
programme.desc: After escorting an Emir's daughter to her father's stronghold, French Foreign Legion Captain Gerard's unit joins an isolated Moroccan outpost facing imminent attack by rebel Bedouin tribes.

programme.title: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: A dimwitted busboy at a beatnik cafe passes off a cat he accidentally killed and covered in plaster as a sculpture, prompting a demand for more art that compels him to commit murders.

programme.title: Django, Kill!
programme.desc: Various factions, including a half-breed bandit, a gang of homosexual cowboys, and a priest, feud over stolen gold in a surreal town

programme.title: The Gabby Hayes Show - Muscles
programme.desc: Dramatizing the lives of historical figures, such as the naval commander, the lawman and professional gambler, and the outlaw Belle, tall tales and Western scenes

programme.title: Rough Riders' Round-Up
programme.desc: Now that the Spanish-American war is over, Roy and other Rough Riders become border patrolmen. Their goal is to stop outlaws who are stealing gold from stagecoaches and express offices.

programme.title: The Crooked Trail
programme.desc: Jim Blake rescues criminal Hare Talton and Good Samaritan Estaban Solano from dehydration and death and tries to rehabilitate Harve by taking him in as partner in his gold strike.

programme.title: Rough Riders' Round-Up
programme.desc: Now that the Spanish-American war is over, Roy and other Rough Riders become border patrolmen. Their goal is to stop outlaws who are stealing gold from stagecoaches and express offices.

programme.title: Guns Of Diablo 1964
programme.desc: Charles Bronson stars as rugged scout Linc Murdock, caught in a feud with rancher Rance Macklin over the enchanting Maria. Packed with action, rivalry, and frontier grit, this Western drama also showcases a young Kurt Russell in one of his earliest roles!

programme.title: Sixgun Rhythm 1939
programme.desc: Melody meets mayhem in Sixgun Rhythm! When a singing cowboy rides into a town plagued by outlaws, he must trade his guitar for a six-shooter to defend the innocent. With gun-blazing action, spirited songs, and a dash of romance, this musical Western hits all the right notes of frontier adventure.

programme.title: Wolves of the Range
programme.desc: Dorn is after the rancher's land and is trying to stop Banker Brady from helping them. When his man Hammond kills Brady, there is a run on the bank and Rocky volunteers to ride to the next town for money.

programme.title: In Old Caliente
programme.desc: Americans come West to California in the hope of peaceful settlement.

programme.title: Dead for a Dollar
programme.desc: "Cowboy" has killed the son of a rancher who is now on his heels. He meets a Confederate soldier searching for a treasure. But others have picked up the scent of the gold as well, and soon the duo is pursued by Union and Mexican soldiers.

programme.title: Massacre Time 1966
programme.desc: In Massacre Time, Franco Nero blazes onto the Spaghetti Western scene as Tom Corbett, a drifter who returns home to find his family’s land stolen and his brother living in ruin. Together, the two face a ruthless tyrant and his sadistic son who rule with terror and bloodshed. Directed by Lucio Fulci, this violent, gripping tale delivers brutal gunfights, raw emotion, and the relentless pursuit of vengeance.

programme.title: Arizona Stage Coach
programme.desc: The Range Busters help a young man framed as the leader of an outlaw gang that has been holding up stage coaches.

programme.title: Heart of the Golden West
programme.desc: Lambert owns the trucking line that ships cattle to market. When he raises his rates Roy decides to ship the cattle on the River Boat. When Lambert and his men are unable to stop the boat, they rustle the cattle.

programme.title: The Brothers O'Toole 1973
programme.desc: In The Brothers O’Toole, Tim Conway and John Astin star in a rollicking Western comedy of mistaken identity and small-town chaos. When two lookalike drifters stumble into a struggling frontier town, one is hailed as a hero while the other is branded an outlaw. Their misadventures set off a whirlwind of mix-ups, scams, and slapstick mayhem. With sharp wit, lively performances, and a playful twist on Western tradition, this offbeat comedy delivers laughs as big as the open range.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Wealthy rancher G. W. McLintock uses his power and influence in the territory to keep the peace between farmers, ranchers, land-grabbers, Indians and corrupt government officials.

programme.title: Bells of Rosarita
programme.desc: Sue Farnum inherits a circus, but her dead father's partner is trying to take it away from her. Roy and Bob Nolan are filming a movie on location at the circus. They and a number of other western movie stars come to Sue's aid, putting on a show and catching the bad guys.

programme.title: Gunfight at Red Sands 1963
programme.desc: In Gunfight at Red Sands, Richard Harrison rides into a border town torn apart by greed and violence. When ruthless bandits threaten the land and its people, a mysterious gunman takes justice into his own hands. With sweeping desert vistas, tense standoffs, and the first-ever Spaghetti Western score by Ennio Morricone, this action-packed tale blazes with the grit and glory of the frontier.

programme.title: Mclintock! 1963
programme.desc: John Wayne leads the charge in McLintock!, a rip-roaring Western comedy brimming with action, romance, and frontier spirit. As wealthy cattle baron George Washington McLintock tries to keep the peace between feuding homesteaders, rowdy cowhands, and local Native tribes, he also faces his toughest battle yet—his fiery estranged wife (Maureen O’Hara), who’s just returned to town. Filled with slapstick brawls, lively banter, and heartwarming humor, McLintock! delivers classic Western entertainment with larger-than-life charm.

programme.title: Identity Unknown
programme.desc: An amnesiac soldier, the only survivor of a group of four unidentified soldiers - victims of a bomb raid - visits each man's address with the hope of restoring his memory and identity

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Paris
programme.desc: An American journalist returns to Paris - a city that gave him true love and deep grief.

programme.title: Mitchell (1975 color)
programme.desc: A tough, slobby, honest cop tries to simultaneously take down heroin dealers and a corrupt businessman who murdered a burglar, even if it costs him his life.

programme.title: The Phantom Creeps
programme.desc: A military intelligence officer and a pretty reporter try to find a scientist whose inventions can destroy the world.

programme.title: Oliver Twist (1933) Colorized
programme.desc: An orphan boy in 1830s London is abused in a workhouse, then falls into the clutches of a gang of thieves.

programme.title: Peter Pan (1924) Colorized
programme.desc: Peter Pan enters the nursery of the Darling children and, with the help of fairy dust, leads them off to Never Never Land, where they meet the nefarious Captain Hook.

programme.title: The World Gone Mad : Starring Pat O'Brien
programme.desc: A district attorney and a reporter try to find the killer of a D.A. who uncovered a massive stock fraud.

programme.title: Bluebeard Starring John Carradine
programme.desc: In Paris, an artist hires portrait models, and after he finishes their portraits, he strangles them.

programme.title: The Mad Monster
programme.desc: A mad scientist changes his simple-minded handyman into a werewolf in order to prove his supposedly crazy scientific theories - and exact revenge.

programme.title: The Vampire Bat
programme.desc: When corpses drained of blood begin to show up in a European village, vampirism is suspected to be responsible.

programme.title: Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde Starring John Barrymore
programme.desc: Dr. Henry Jekyll experiments with scientific means of revealing the hidden, dark side of man and releases a murderer from within himself.

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Paris
programme.desc: An American journalist returns to Paris - a city that gave him true love and deep grief.

programme.title: Captian Kidd (1945) Colorized
programme.desc: The unhistorical adventures of pirate Captain Kidd revolve around treasure and treachery.

programme.title: Idaho
programme.desc: A deputy sets out to prove that a respected judge, who had once been a criminal, is being framed for crimes committed by a crooked saloon owner

programme.title: Detour
programme.desc: The life of Al Roberts, a pianist in a New York nightclub, turns into a nightmare when he decides to hitchhike to Los Angeles to visit his girlfriend.

programme.title: Bodyguard Kiba
programme.desc: Karate master and anti-drug vigilante Kiba returns to his home in Japan, where he aims to wipe out the nation's drug industry.

programme.title: Black Cobra 3
programme.desc: A shipment of American weapons is stolen in the Philippines. An American named Hawkins tries to find the weapons. Hawkins ends up dead. Chicago policeman Bob Malone is called in to investigate. Along with Interpol agent Greg Duncan, Malone travels the streets of Manila, tracking down leads.

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: A young man, hounded by a psychopathic general, learns martial arts at the Shaolin temple to avenge his father's death. To achieve this he forgoes a budding romance with his kungfu master's daughter, a shepherdess.

programme.title: The Brave in the Kung Fu Shadow
programme.desc: After her father, a judge, is murdered by corrupt officials, a young woman must set out do recover the Blood Rain Sword, which her father had left to her, and encounters obstacles from the villainous Chao Pai

programme.title: Ninja Heat
programme.desc: Two trained ninja fighters take on a gang of thugs; a big city crime boss and his death and destruction.

programme.title: Four Shaolin Challengers
programme.desc: Lin Che Jong, a former student of Wong Fei Hung, is a hawker in a small town. Whe he stands up to gangsters from the local crime family, his fellow hawkers and business folk encourage and help him to open a Kung Fu school in town.

programme.title: Crippled Kung Fu Boxer
programme.desc: Kung fu genius (Cliff Lok) stars as the student of a famous kung fu master whose kung fu gym gets overrun by the Hunchback and his gang, Cliff runs off and seeks refuge with his uncle, who teaches Cliff the art of the Crippled Fist so he may take revenge of the Hunchback and the rest of his vile posse.

programme.title: Kung Fu Kids Break Away
programme.desc: The evil Mr. Chu's control of a village is challenged by a Korean wanderer named Eagle and the three Kung Fu Kids.

programme.title: Dragon Fist
programme.desc: Tong Huo-wan seeks redress from the man responsible for his master's death, but becomes entangled in a feud between a local clan and gangsters.

programme.title: Bruce Against Iron Hand
programme.desc: Tough cop Bruce Li arrives back in town in time to investigate a series of odd murders.

programme.title: Death Machines
programme.desc: An evil Dragon Lady injects three martial arts fighters with a serum that turns them into zombie-like assassins.

programme.title: Black Fist
programme.desc: To make money, a Los Angeles street-fighter goes to work for gangsters.

programme.title: Superchick
programme.desc: Tara B. True is a flight attendant who makes a weekly swing through New York, Miami, and Los Angeles.

programme.title: Spirits of Bruce Lee
programme.desc: Chang Chen-Wai, a martial arts expert who runs a jade-importing business, follows his missing brother to Thailand and learns he has been murdered. Chang vows revenge

programme.desc: The wagoners stop in a town that appears to have been abandoned very suddenly.

programme.desc: Inspector Leduque comes from New Orleans to Virginia City to take Ben Cartwright back for a 20 year murder. programme.title: Cowboy G-Men

programme.title: Billy The Kid's Gun Justice
programme.desc: The third in the series of six PRC westerns starring Bob Steele as Billy the Kid (Bob Steele, finds Billy and his pals, Jeff Blanchard and Fuzzy Jones ambushed in a cabin and, as they are making their getaway, Jeff is wounded.

programme.title: Jory
programme.desc: Jory is a fifteen-year-old boy who joins a horse-drive after his father is killed by a drunkard. The drive's leader and a likable cowhand take the boy under their wing, and find that tragedy has taught him how to take care of himself better than anyone could expect. Jory proves his new found manhood in the finale's thundering stampede and shootout.

programme.title: Savage Guns
programme.desc: A cruel and ruthless bandit kills a tavern owner, who had ratted him out to the authorities. Sam Wallach witnesses the murder, as well as the murder of his brother, who happens to get in the way of the bandit. Sam swears revenge, and sets out for blood.

programme.title: Deadwood '76
programme.desc: A young drifter is mistaken for Billy the Kid. The consequences prove deadly.

programme.title: Miracle in the Valley
programme.desc: Thirteen-year-old Melinda is determined to find out what happened to her real Daddy, and no one in Boonville will help her.

programme.title: Battles Of Chief Pontiac
programme.desc: During the 1700s, in the Great Lakes region the British troops have driven the French out and with help from the mercenary Hessian troops the British plan to annihilate the native tribes.

programme.title: Molly and Lawless John
programme.desc: In New Mexico, a sheriff's unhappy mid-aged wife aids a condemned prisoner escape her husband's jail and elopes with the young and attractive outlaw to Mexico, pursued by the sheriff's posse.

programme.title: Between Men
programme.desc: When his young son is shot, John Wellington kills the culprit and flees. But his son Johnny recovers and is raised by Sir George. Some twenty years later Johnny sets out to find Sir George's missing granddaughter. He finds her and also finds Rand, but neither of the two men realize they are father and son.

programme.title: Buckskin Frontier
programme.desc: A railroad man and the owner of a freight line battle for control of a crucial mountain pass.

programme.title: Powderkeg
programme.desc: Just before World War I, two adventurers are hired to bring back a hijacked train from Mexico.

programme.title: The Renegade Ranger
programme.desc: Texas Ranger Jack Steele is assigned to bring in former ranch owner Judith Alvarez, now the leader of a gang who is waging war against the crooked government officials who cheated the ranchers out of their land.

programme.title: Border Caballero
programme.desc: Tex Weaver is working undercover to bring in a gang of bank robbers. When he is killed, Tim Ross, a marksman with Doc Shaw's traveling show, takes over. Posing as a Mexican he lays a trap for the gang.

programme.title: The Desperate Mission
programme.desc: A man who has lost everything joins others paid to convey a wealthy man's wife - and a mysterious treasure - to safety in San Francissco.

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Sheriff John Higgins quits and goes into prospecting after he thinks he has killed his best friend in shooting it out with robbers. He encounters his dead buddy's sister and helps her run her ranch. Then she finds out about his past.

programme.desc: En este episodio de Momento de DESmadre, conversamos con la terapeuta familiar Erika Ángulo sobre uno de los temas más desafiantes para muchas madres: la adolescencia de los hijos y el duelo emocional que sentimos al verlos crecer y empezar a soltarse de nuestra mano. Hablamos sobre cómo manejar la etapa de la "aborrecencia", entender los cambios emocionales y de comportamiento de los adolescentes, y cómo las mamás podemos vivir este proceso sin tanta culpa, con herramientas que nos ayuden a conectar desde el amor y la empatía.

programme.title: ¿Las pantallas están criando a tus hijos? Sol Macaluso y Fátima de Francisco en Matronas al Rescate
programme.desc: uevo programa de Matronas al Rescate en Canal Barro — y esta vez tocamos uno de los temas más urgentes: cómo las pantallas, las redes sociales y la inteligencia artificial están afectando a la infancia. Las invitadas de lujo fueron:

programme.title: Ángela Cremonte le da un zasca a los gobernantes en Matronas al Rescate
programme.desc: Nueva entrega de Matronas al Rescate en Canal Barro. Hoy nos visita Ángela Cremonte, actriz española, que nos abrió su corazón para hablar de su parto, postparto y la realidad de la maternidad. Pero lo más fuerte fueron los zascas al gobierno, denunciando la invisibilización de las madres y la falta de apoyo real. Un testimonio valiente y necesario. Además: Emma Salado recordó el parto de Gema Clavero, al que asistió, compartiendo fotos inéditas y anécdotas divertidas. Gema nos sorprendió otra vez hablando de la vida sexual de su amiga… sin pelos en la lengua. Y en la sección de noticias: llegan los condones de colores que detectan enfermedades de transmisión sexual. Sí, lo has leído bien. Un programón que mezcla ciencia, maternidad real y mucho humor.

programme.title: Until We Meet Again- Oregon Turkey Hunt with Rick Carone
programme.desc: Success afield is marked by many things- the only one that truly matters is enjoying the outdoors and the experience with the people that we love. In the latest episode of Pursue The Wild, Kristy Titus hunts turkeys in Oregon celebrating friendship and sharing her final hunt with her beloved friend Rick Carone. Armed with the God given gift of leadership and the ability to inspire the hearts of all who meet him, Rick Carone, lived purposefully and passionately. At the age of 42, Rick faced head on a diagnosis of Pancreatic Cancer. The doctors gave Rick statistics that offered him a 15% chance of surviving beyond year one, but Rick was not one to let adversity and challenge slow him down. Brought to his knees by his diagnosis, Rick found the strength to stand up and fight with the power of his self-proclaimed triple threat of attack on cancer, Faith, Family and Friends. With a God given purpose, Rick shared his incredible personal story with the nation- he inspired the dreams and hopes of others touching the most important landscape- our hearts, helping to raise awareness and helping the fight to shut down cancer. After a four year battle, on June 29th, Rick Carone was called home. He did not lose his battle with cancer, he used his battle to leave a legacy that will now be carried on by the friends that loved him. To continue Rick's fight to shut down cancer go to www.teamcarone.com.

programme.title: Antelope Wellington

programme.title: Squatterz S5 The Big Bang Break
programme.desc: Esiri and Raymond developed an app that can read into the mind of anyone by analyzing their current emotion and got an endorsement for it. The company sends a representative to get them to sign the agreements and everything goes south from there.

programme.title: Squatterz S5 How I Met Your Mother
programme.desc: Papa’a mother came again and this time all the squatters left the house so she wouldn’t meet them at home. She meets Esiri and realized their initial meeting was just a fluke. They get to know each other and a flirting relationship starts to everyone especially Papa’s disgust. Meanwhile, Sege is still looking for the missing Rachel.

programme.title: Squatterz S6 Living In Bondage
programme.desc: Aliyah, Voke and Chinwe are in the living room fighting karate. Voke and Chinwe team together to fight Aliyah but she dealt with them, Voke took a book to hit Aliyah unfortunately the book hit Shege’s face. They were all placed on a punishment not to leave the house for a week but Aliyah has work to do now they have to come together again to safe their stay in the house. Aliyah planned to teach them Voke and Chinwe a lesson.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Shakespeare In Love
programme.desc: Sege’s cousin came visiting and Buchi fell genuinely in love with her. He does everything to get her attention and when he finally gets it, he realizes they can’t be together.

programme.title: Squatterz S4 Thou Shall Not Allow Any Parent Stay In The House
programme.desc: Papa decides to get a girl on a contract basis from Sureboy to deceive his mother that he has a stable relationship, but Sureboy, as usual, brought someone worse than Papa can ever imagine, and his mother was more surprised than ever. Esiri had to come to his rescue.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S3 It's A No
programme.desc: Tare is finding it very hard to believe her husband’s decision and support it. She expresses her disagreement and refuses to support his decision. Garba, her husband’s driver, would not stop coming to the house and as much as she tries, her sister Sotonye, who is living with them hears the resignation news.

programme.title: Squatterz S6 Checkmate
programme.desc: A military man asked Aliyah hands in marriage. Voke and Chinwe deceitfully collected money from the man. They convinced Aliyah that she's old enough to be married with different tactics; even Papa tried to advise her to have a man in her life. They lured Aliyah to have a date with the old man. Voke had a dream that the military men beat them.

programme.title: Squatterz S2 Squatterz VS Squatterz
programme.desc: Papa brings one of his female friends over for a visit. It was supposed to be a visit, but she refused to leave and kept cooking up reasons to stay back. She ended up bringing her friend,s and they became the female squatters with the intention of throwing Papa and his friends out of the house.

programme.title: Squatterz S1 Unwanted Visitor
programme.desc: Sege’s aunt, Temi, stays with the squatters and gives them a tough time. The squatters plot a way to get her out of the house without getting on Sege’s nerves.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 Breaking News
programme.desc: Justice Tunde Abiola fell in love with his nurse Uche, and decided to marry her. He introduces her to his children, who were not going to have any of it as they devise schemes to destroy the union.

programme.title: Squatterz S4 Thou Shall Not Hold Any Houseparty
programme.desc: Dorothy wants to throw a birthday party which would flout the house commandments Sege gave them. She decides to manipulate her way to get the guys support. Sege caught them having a party in the house when he brought his business partner home, and would have thrown them out if not for a miracle that happened.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S4 The Visit
programme.desc: Tare flared up when she found out that her sister Sotonye brought a friend to the house without asking her permission, and Tokunbo allowed Garba’s brother and wife to come spend the night in their house without telling her. The bank also brings a letter to inform the that they have a month to pay back the loan or lose the house but help comes not looking like help sometimes.

programme.title: Squatterz S2 Papa Gets HIV
programme.desc: Tough times don’t last for long, but this seems to be lasting quite long. Papa is at his lowest, and Buchi makes sure he rubs it in and takes advantage of this situation. But is there light at the end of the tunnel for Papa, or would this be the end of him?

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 Wedding Party
programme.desc: Sade and Soji continue to devise new schemes to ruin their father’s union with Uche. He announces their wedding plans and puts Sade in charge of the event planning.

programme.title: Squatterz S6 Living In Bondage
programme.desc: Aliyah, Voke and Chinwe are in the living room fighting karate. Voke and Chinwe team together to fight Aliyah but she dealt with them, Voke took a book to hit Aliyah unfortunately, the book hit Shege’s face. They were all placed on a punishment not to leave the house for a week but Aliyah has work to do now they have to come together again to save their stay in the house. Aliyah planned to teach them Voke and Chinwe a lesson.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Rats
programme.desc: Things started disappearing in the apartment and everyone is a suspect. They think there is a ghost in the house.

programme.title: Squatterz S6 Things Fall Apart
programme.desc: Papa met with an old friend Femi in a bar who was planning on going to the Third Mainland Bridge to jump over the bridge because of his life issues, while papa was also considering doing so, Shege showed up. He told him he had been looking for him. Shege brought him to the new apartment. They agreed not to take in new squatters. Papa took pictures he posted on the internet which opened opportunity for the new squatters. Danjuma asked them to help his sister, Aliyah, a banker to be with them in the house then two other people came in immediately: Voke Papa's nephew and Chinwe his neighbor. Voke and Chinwe are social media influencers. The three of them had to come together to save their stay in the house.

programme.title: Squatterz S1 The Devil You Know
programme.desc: Papa gets into trouble when he introduces an agent his friend Sureboy to help sell a land and Sureboy decides to cheat and defraud the agent. Papa gets an ultimatum from the agent to provide the money or face jail.

programme.title: Squatterz S2 Danjuma And Cougar
programme.desc: Danjuma hooks up with an older woman, and soon an affectionate relationship began. Danjuma is torn between letting this relationship continue or ending it and going back to his girlfriend.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Three And A Half Men
programme.desc: Tosin, Buchi’s baby mama, dropped their son, Yinka, with him because she was traveling. Yinka’s first week with Buchi proves to be tougher than it was imagined.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 Sleeping Beauty
programme.desc: Shade is not happy with everyone in the house because she thought they forgot her birthday, now they all have to figure out what she wants for her birthday gift. They all came up with different ideas, but only Soji was able to figure it out. Shade wanted to see her dream music artist, STYL PLUS

programme.title: Squatterz S4 Thou Shall Not Allow Any Couple Reside In The Apartment
programme.desc: Papa and Dorothy enter a trance individually about them getting married, and one thing they had in common was Esiri ruining the wedding.

programme.title: Squatterz S1 Birds Of The Same Feather
programme.desc: Papa’s mother came visiting to remind Papa of his single status and tell him to get married, and to inform him that his younger brother was getting married. She meets Vicky and Papa in a compromising situation and would not have any of that. Buchi uses the opportunity to act like the good kid, but he has his skeletons too…

programme.title: Squatterz S2 Singing Shege
programme.desc: Under the leadership of Sege, the squatters decide to go for a music contest where they get the chance to win five million naira. They finally have the chance to pay their rent.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S3 Book Of Life
programme.desc: Garba continues to ruin chances for Sotonye, who is trying to make ends meet, even if it is by pretending to be what she is not. Garba’s continued presence begins to raise suspicions as Tokunbo has resigned from the bank and does not need a driver anymore but loyalty is strong and it cannot be bought. Tare suggests Tokunbo gets a helping hand to help him at the farm

programme.title: Squatterz S4 Thou Shall Not Be Caught
programme.desc: The constant flouting of the house commandments let to Sege making Raymond a whistle blower. Raymond becomes the whistle blower against the other squatters and they plot to ‘whistle blow’ the whistle blower and Sege…but does Raymond and Sege have skeletons too?

programme.title: Squatterz S6 Lord Of The Ring
programme.desc: Chinwe continues to throw her tantrum. She put Aliyah's things out of the room and she continued to say Voke must break up with Aliyah. At the end, a man came in to propose to Chinwe.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Shakespeare In Love
programme.desc: Sege’s cousin came visiting and Buchi fell genuinely in love with her. He does everything to get her attention and when he finally gets it, he realizes they can’t be together.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Fried Kidneys
programme.desc: When the pill sampling did not work, Buchi decides to sell one of his kidneys for money, he would have but for Papa's timely intervention.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S2 Surrogate
programme.desc: Uche finally gets a golden opportunity she has waited for all her life but she fell ill, thinking this was just a minor sickness, she did a test, and the results reveal otherwise.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Rats
programme.desc: Things started disappearing in the apartment and everyone is a suspect. They think there is a ghost in the house.

programme.title: Squatterz S5 It's Sureboy Again! Part 2
programme.desc: To get a man, use his weakness they say…Sureboy uses Shege’s weakness to make his hand over his house, is this the end of the squatters? Or would a miracle happen?

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 Prenup: The Revelation
programme.desc: Uche found out the prenup Justice Babatunde wrote and she felt disappointed and betrayed.

programme.title: Squatterz S1 Bomb In The House
programme.desc: Jobless Buchi walks into the apartment and hears a strange and unfamiliar sound from a handbag on the table, he alerts the remaining squatters that a bomb is in the house. The panic of the bomb detonating pushes them to consider leaving the house. The bag turned out to belong to Sege’s aunty

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Fried Kidneys
programme.desc: When the pill sampling did not work, Buchi decides to sell one of his kidneys for money, he would have but for Papa's timely intervention.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Insult To Injury
programme.desc: Esiri gets into trouble with the squatters because of his clumsiness, and they beat the hell out of him. He became incapacitated for too long, and it was beginning to look fake. How do they expose him?? His weakness…

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Law And Order
programme.desc: Buchi’s mother came to visit them, and her lifestyle is totally different from the Squatterz lifestyle. They struggle to endure her visit, but there is only so much they can take, and they decide to give her a taste of her own medicine.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S3 Turning Point
programme.desc: Tokunbo’s friend from the bank came to visit with his family and mentioned an investment opportunity that is available for livestock farmers, but he had to make an initial deposit he does not have. Tare encouraged him to use the house as collateral for a loan.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S3 Stranger Things
programme.desc: Sotonye had an interview in the house where she lied about owning the house. Garba hears this and exposes her lie, and a fight ensues between them. Tare suspects a strange behavior in her son, Obafemi, and tells Tokunbo about it. But he says it is all part of teenage life. Was her instinct right?

programme.title: Squatterz S4 Insurance Lady
programme.desc: The insurance lady who was sent to investigate the cause of the fire, Dorothy, got engaged with the squatters, and after the cause of the fire, she decided to stay back, unknowingly to the owner of the house, but with the help of one of the squatters. Sege later finds out and feels betrayed.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S2 Cold Water
programme.desc: Uche invites Soji to do something for free for her book club but he was never going to until he passed the venue and saw Femi. He fell in love and became a devoted member of the book club. His father disapproved of him entering a relationship.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Welcome Miss Amanda
programme.desc: Danjuma leaves the apartment to further his education. Sege brought a friend’s sister to squat with them for her NYSC.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Shakespeare In Love
programme.desc: Sege’s cousin came visiting and Buchi fell genuinely in love with her. He does everything to get her attention and when he finally gets it, he realizes they can’t be together.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 Wedding Party Part2
programme.desc: This was Sade’s chance to finally destroy the wedding, but she was to meet the shock of her life.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S2 Love Child
programme.desc: Uche stumbled on an old secret about her husband while he was away and this pushed their marriage to the brink of an end. What happens next?

programme.title: Squatterz S2 Squatterz VS Squatterz
programme.desc: Papa brings one of his female friends over for a visit. It was supposed to be a visit, but she refused to leave and kept cooking up reasons to stay back. She ended up bringing her friend,s and they became the female squatters with the intention of throwing Papa and his friends out of the house.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - GP Spain - Ski
Speed Catamarans GC32 - Episode 4
programme.desc: The race course of Riva del Garda is well-known for its dramatic cliff face and 1000m mountain peaks on its west shore as well as the typically strong wind and flat-water conditions. It’s the 5th time Lake Garda has hosted the foiling catamarans as part of the GC32 Racing Tour. The heavyweight battle at the top of the leaderboard was between the Adam Minoprio-skippered Oman Air and Ernesto Bertarelli’s Alinghi, helmed this week by Swiss ace Arnaud Psarofaghis. These two teams sit on the top of the leaderboard on equal points after 3 of the 5 events this season. Heading into the Riva del Garda event, holding third were the Austrian Olympic Tornado double gold medallists Roman Hagara and Hans-Peter Steinacher and their Red Bull Sailing Team. In this episode, we dive into the action of the GC32 Racing Tour in Riva.

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez - Meetings at St Tropez
programme.desc: Les Voiles de St Tropez Regatta is the closing event of the summer season in St Tropez and the Riviera. For the 2017 edition of this event, over 300 of the most amazing sailing yachts from all over the world - classic and modern - plus 3500 crew, unite in St Tropez for a week of racing and festivities. Join us on Nautical Channel for the latest action at Les Voiles de Saint Tropez!

programme.title: Semaine Du Golfe Du Morbihan
programme.desc: The Semaine du Golfe Du Morbihan is an essential event for all classic sailing lovers. The Gulf Week is a maritime even set on the beautiful Morbihan Gulf, in Brittany, a French destination known for its gorgeous landscape. Expending on 35000 hectares, it is worth is reputation as the little sea. For one week, the Gulf will be letting more than 1000 ships rip through its waters. Rowing boats, lightships, classic sailing ships... almost 6000 sailors will take part in this year's edition. This joyful week has been organised in order to meet and share new experiences, so let's enduge in the best moments, most impressive boats and latest news of the 7th edition of the Semaine du Golfe Du Morbihan!

programme.title: Un día en...Salón Internacional Náutico de Barcelona - Salón Internacional Barcelona - Ep4
Cannes Yachting Festival - Episode 1
programme.desc: The glamorous city of Cannes hosts the luxury Yachting Festival par excellence for the 40th time this year and a new Luxury Gallery has been opened in the Palais de Festivals to celebrate this landmark anniversary. Breathe in the boat show’s opulence and learn about the latest trends in the yachting world!

programme.title: Skagerrak
programme.desc: SKAGERRAK follows the preparation and mental development of the Danish professional stand up paddle athlete Casper Steinfath in his attempt to be the first person in the world to paddle from Denmark to Norway.In his journey, brotherhood and friendship come to play an essential part making a dream and project like the crossing of an entire ocean come true. SKAGERRAK will take you behind the scenes of mainstream media and portrays the Northern and secluded region of Denmark called Thy, where Casper grew up.A region, where a pioneer spirit and desire for independence prevails despite adversity and isolation. SKAGERRAK is an inspirational story that touches upon the dreams, aspirations, and desires that live inside all of us. A film about the courage to reach for the horizon.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 5
programme.desc: One of the many charms of the island of Vis lies in its 500 years long isolation as a military island. Vis has an unspoiled nature, magical beaches and the hospitality of its people is so authentic it will make you want to stay in this place forever. In this episode of Sail-Ho, we will be exploring this charming island.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 6
programme.desc: Hello sailors! In this episode we will be island hopping the Zadar archipelago. We will visit the islands of Ugljan, Pašman and Pag, and our first stop will be the Ugljan, also known as the Olive Island. This is one of the most picturesque islands of the entire archipelago, so it will be a great start.

programme.title: New York - Vendée Transatlantic Race
programme.desc: This single-handed yacht race will cross the Northern Atlantic through two symbolic cities: New York and Sables d’Olonne. The departure from the Big Apple represents a cosmopolitan crossroad of influences, as well as the cradle of the IMOCA Class, while the arrival in the Sables d’Olonne means landing in the Old Continent after days or weeks of harsh conditions.After crossing a risky and challenging course straight through the middle of the “iceberg alley”, the skippers will arrive in the heart of the Vendée Globe considered as the “Everest of the Sea”. The Transatlantic race is the final event of the IMOCA Globe Series and it allows racers to build their hard racing miles. It represents a further opportunity to reinforce its image as a marine region, thus it is an awaited event for all those sailors thinking about embarking on the Vendée Globe.Follow their journey from New York to Sables d’Olonne in New York – Vendée Transatlantic Race. Available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode, we are in the TwinTip open Worlds in Hangloose beach, Italy where Florian Gruber has defended his title for the 3rd time! Then, we are set to join the Kite World Series in China’s Weifang and Pingtan where the fastest foilers are ready to set new records in kite foiling. We finish our journey at the final of the series that took place in Cagliari, Italy where Maxim Nocher has been crowned Champion of the series.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode we will focus on the action around the 2019 Kite Foil World Series, which is composed by four non-discard events. This means that all the event scores will be counted. The series began in Gizzeria, Italy and will head to China’s Pingtan and Weifang in September for two successive, action packed events before concluding in Cagliari, Italy. With the latter being the place where the male and female of 2019 Kite Foil World Champions will be crowned.

programme.title: Brilliant Corners Barbados
programme.desc: The Caribbean is filled with places where tourism is rare or close to non-existent. However, there is so much potential for cultural and water sports tourism, they are called Brilliant corners. Nautical Channel is on a mission to explore the brilliant corners of the Caribbean.Going from Haiti all the way to Jamaica or Barbados, we will dive into these brilliant corners, many of them with no tourism at all. With a sustainable tourism approach, get ready to live a fully local experience on Brilliant Corners Barbados while we practice water sports, taste the traditional local dishes and talk with the habitants of the area.On this occasion, we venture into Barbados: an eastern Caribbean island with colonial buildings, botanical gardens and 17th century plantation houses. Join Sam Bleakly, a travel writer, surfer, and a lecturer in cultural tourism, as he takes you under the skin of the coastline and inner parts of Barbados.

programme.title: Flavours Of The Sea - Episode 3
programme.desc: Chef Nikolaos is giving us a well-needed cooking lesson before jumping on board to prepare the recipe he has in store for us. He will also take the time to teach us how to find out whether if a fish is fresh or not before we go on and try the dish with the people from the port. Then, we are meeting with the young Chef Jason, who with only 19 years is the main chef at a 4-star hotel. He is cooking on board our boat, and we are excited to try out his dish.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 7
programme.desc: In this new episode of Sail-Ho we are visiting Dugi Otok, the longest and biggest island of the Zadar archipelago. It is also the 2nd most indented island in all of the Adriatic Sea, with gorgeous beaches and beautiful nature we believe is worth exploring completely. Come join us in this new adventure!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 8
programme.desc: Welcome to Sail-Ho Croatia! We're in Rab, the island known by many as the island of love and happiness since Roman times. It has more than 30 sandy beaches, 2500 hours of sunshine and a mouthwatering gastronomy. Come join us and find out why this place is considered a happy place by so many!

programme.title: Ocean Safari - Kenya - Episode 3
programme.desc: We venture into Kenya’s wild coastline in the Watamu region. This Marine reserve is incredibly unique and in order for Andi to truly experience it she has to learn to kite surf in a very short period of time. She needs help, so she decides to track down the Tribe Watersports and Ben Kelliher who will guide her through a crash course in kitesurfing. If she can do it in the allocated time, Ben has an incredible prize waiting for her.

programme.title: Ocean Safari - Kenya - Episode 4
programme.desc: Andi is back in the Watamu Marine Reserve but this time on a new mission: save the endangered sea turtles. She spends three days at the Local Ocean Trust with Marine Biologist Casper van de Geer. If Andi can learn the importance of sea turtles in the marine ecosystem and the vital skills needed to protect them, she might have the opportunity to release a turtle back into the wild.

programme.title: Artist Profile - Scott Lenhardt
programme.desc: Artist Scott Lenhardt has kept everything he’s ever made for Burton Snowboards. Everything he’s ever done is stored in his childhood bedroom. After his year-long solo show at the Vermont Ski & Snowboard Museum, he organized his archives. Just like his creative process, this film is mind blowing.

programme.title: Artist Profile - Sebo Walker
programme.desc: In 2022, the art-inspired accessories brand Slowtide launched a summer collection with Portland, Oregon-based artist and skateboarder Sebo Walker. To capture the collaboration, director Jake Price spent a day cruising around Walker’s hometown, seeing the city and learning what inspires his artwork.

programme.title: Without a Paddle
programme.desc: ‘Without a Paddle’ is a canoe film about snowboarding. Four snowboarders retrace a portion of the 19th century explorer David Thompson’s journey down the Columbia River, during one of the coldest cold snaps in Revelstoke’s recorded history. Surreal landscapes, epic paddling, deep powder, and pain.

programme.title: Without a Pedal
programme.desc: Snowboarding Alaska the hard way. An epic winter bike trip down Canada’s Cassiar Highway turns into a test of survival, obsession, and how far you’ll go for the dream.

programme.title: Northbound and Around
programme.desc: Hungry for clips and greedy for turns, Johan Rosen, Garrett “Worm” Warnick and friends spent the season leaving no line unridden and no pillow unsmashed. Driven by the most unsatisfiable of desires, finding good snow, the crew spent the season running from warm temperatures and chasing down a dream. To get to the promised land, they found themselves traveling… Northbound and Around. Featuring: Garrett Warnick, Johan Rosen, Nils Arvidsson, Ryan Paterson, Keenan Filmer, Kareem El Rafie Nils Mindnich, Jess Kimura, Bode Merrill, Ben Bilocq, Brandon Davis, Nick Khattar, Kyle Mack Edited by: Johan Rosen

programme.title: CHANNEL ZeRO
programme.desc: Released in 2020, this Absinthe Films feature highlights the unifying power of snowboarding during a divisive moment in history, celebrating a global community that refuses to be separated by physical or mental barriers.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Jamie Lynn - Dose 01
programme.desc: Jamie Lynn is an introvert. In his snowboarding and art-making, however, he’s big and expressive. Watch Episode 1 of his legendary Microdose series. Featuring Circe Wallace, Mike Hatchett, Sean Sullivan, Temple Cummins, Jason Loeb, Micah Shapiro, Colter Gerber, Apostalos and Demetrius Karabotsos.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Jamie Lynn - Dose 02
programme.desc: In Episode 2 of the Jamie Lynn series, Jamie talks about how the creativity of the artists and skateboarders Mark Gonzales and Neil Blender guides his approach to life as a snowboarder and artist. Featuring Circe Wallace, Matt Cummins, Dano Pendygrasse, Joel Gomez, Scott Sullivan, and Matt Remine.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Jamie Lynn - Dose 03
programme.desc: In Episode 3 of the Jamie Lynn Microdose series, we talk with a pioneering professional snowboarder and filmmaker, an iconic 90s shredder, and a Tahoe photographer about Jamie Lynn. Join us for tales of guts, gusto, and good jumping genes. Featuring Dave Seoane, Peter Line, and Ruben Sanchez.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Jamie Lynn - Dose 04
programme.desc: In Episode 4 of the Jamie Lynn Microdose series we talk with a handful of Jamie’s fellow athletes and industry peers about his loyalties to Sessions, Volcom, Vans, and LibTech among other sponsors. Featuring Joel Gomez, Dave Seoane, Richard Woolcott, Bryan Iguchi, Mike Parillo, and Billy Anderson.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Jamie Lynn - Dose 05
programme.desc: In Episode 5 of the Jamie Lynn Microdose series, Terje Haakonsen shares his insights on Mr. Lynn. From annual meet-ups at Mt. Baker to destinations around the world, Terje takes you there. Featuring Terje Haakonsen, Bryan Iguchi, Richard Woolcott, Ryan Immegart, Mike Parillo, and Troy Eckert.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Jamie Lynn - Dose 06
programme.desc: In Episode 6 of the Jamie Lynn Microdose series, Jamie details the process of filming the iconic Volcom snowboarding movie, ‘The Garden,’ directed by Richard Woolcott. Spoiler Alert: The experience was awesome. Featuring Troy Eckert, Tucker Hall, Billy Anderson, Nicholas Adams, and Mike Parillo.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Jamie Lynn - Dose 07
programme.desc: In Episode 7, we set the snowboarding tales aside to go deep on Jamie Lynn’s passion for art-making. Tune-in to learn how Lynn’s tight-knit crew motivated one another, both on and off the hill, to pursue parallel paths in visual art. Featuring Bryan Iguchi, Schoph, Jamie Heinrich and Pete Saari.

programme.title: Speak Two The Wind - Part 1: California to Arizona
programme.desc: In Episode 1, the Volcom Skate Team ride motorcycles through the California and Arizona deserts, embracing all that the open road has to offer. Featuring Collin Provost, Arto Saari, Remy Stratton, Chris Pfanner, Jelle Keppens, Jackson Pilz, Jake Smith, Christian Vankelst, and Lannie Rhoades.

programme.title: Speak Two The Wind - Part 2: Arizona to Utah
programme.desc: In Episode 2, the Volcom Skate Team find themselves motorcycling and skateboarding through Arizona and Utah, with a stop at the Grand Canyon. Featuring Collin Provost, Arto Saari, Remy Stratton, Chris Pfanner, Jelle Keppens, Jackson Pilz, Jake Smith, Christian Vankelst, and Lannie Rhoades.

programme.title: Speak Two The Wind - Part 3: Belgium to Germany
programme.desc: In Episode 3, the Volcom Skate Team motorcycle through Belgium and Germany, ride skateboards, and visit The Picturebooks. Featuring Jonathan Thijs, Chris Pfanner, Jelle Keppens, Jackson Pilz, Jake Smith, Christian Vankelst, Lannie Rhoades, Fynn Grabke, Phillip Mirtschink, Claus Grabke, and Baumi.

programme.title: Speak Two The Wind - Part 4: Germany to Denmark
programme.desc: In Episode 4, the Volcom Skate Team ride through Germany and Denmark. In Copenhagen, they visit Motorious, a vintage motorcycle shop. Featuring Collin Provost, Arto Saari, Chris Pfanner, Jackson Pilz, Jake Smith, Christian Vankelst, Lannie Rhoades, Jelle Keppens, Jonathan Thijs and Kasper Krogh.

programme.title: Speak Two The Wind - Part 6: Mexico
programme.desc: In this bonus episode, skaters CJ Collins, Jackson Pilz, and others ride motorcycles between Mexico City and San Miguel de Allende. Featuring Collin Provost, CJ Collins, Braulio Sagas, Kervin Miranda, Luka Barrena, Arto Saari, Diego Espinoza, Ginther Estrada, Ryan Loughridge, and Lannie Rhoades.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Teenrager
programme.desc: Skater CJ Collins is now part of the Toy Machine Blood Sucking Skateboard Company. To celebrate his son’s 13th birthday, father Chad Collins made a 13-minute edit of CJ footage he’s been compiling over the years. As the title says, CJ’s not a teenager, he’s a teenrager!

programme.title: La Quinta Films Presents: Lines
programme.desc: Lines is a documentary about big mountain snowboarding. The dedication. The nerve. The skill. As we follow the Absinthe Films crew for six weeks in Haines, Alaska, we also explore the colorful characters, history and dangers of big mountain riding. Directed by Axel Pauporté and Flora Richard.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: More
programme.desc: Absinthe raises the bar again. 'More' ushers in a new era of urban riding, deep powder, massive jumps, and the groundbreaking ‘Human Drone’ to bring you closer to snowboarding than ever before.

programme.title: Ride Snowboards Presents: Rough Around The Edges
programme.desc: Rough Around The Edges dives into 30 years of Ride Snowboards. Pow days, lawsuits, trespassing, wild decisions, and relentless innovation. A raw, honest look at the brand that shaped modern riding.

programme.title: Assisted Living
programme.desc: After watching Spencer Schubert’s part in the Torment snowboarding film, “Good Sport,” Mikey Leblanc found himself inspired to get back on the toboggan. One phone call later and the newly formed duo got to work filming "ASSISTED LIVING.” This short-film will have you icing your knees in no time.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Brighton Resort - Episode 01
programme.desc: In our latest MICRODOSE series we aim to explore the most influential resorts and iconic locations in snowboarding history, starting with—that’s right—Brighton Resort in Salt Lake City, Utah. Welcome to Brighton Resort Episode 1 of 5. For many riders young and old, Brighton Resort will forever be the epicenter of the snowboarding world. The plentiful snowfall, terrain parks, lift ops, cat drivers, mechanics, management, cafeteria, cooks, and mountain culture are all first class. Back in the early days, very few ski resorts were willing to take a chance on the newfound “lifestyle sport” of snowboarding, but Brighton took the leap. In doing so, Brighton made all the difference. Within a few years, hundreds of ski areas around the world came to see Brighton’s approach to snowboarding as the gold standard. From the biggest vacation destinations to the smallest trash heaps covered in fake snow, everyone (whether they’ve known it or not) has borrowed from the Brighton playbook. This has made it possible for millions of would-be snowboarders to make their first turns safely in-bounds via rope-tows, chairlifts, and gondola rides. Newbies need not traipse into the backcountry with no snow sense and little skill. For this we have Brighton to thank.

programme.desc: A Chilean experience with Jake Blauvelt and Hana Beaman Film and Edit: Gabe Langlois

programme.desc: Everything is back to normal... But why do we feel that we've lost something? WOLF is a feeling, about mountains and skiing. WOLF is the new movie by Sam Favret. Sequel to the successful FLOW, made during the pandemic in Chamonix. WOLF is quite the opposite, and it makes us think about what was good last winter. programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 1: Julien Regnier
programme.desc: In Episode 1, we meet Julien Regnier. For many years, Regnier has been a central figure in freeskiing. First, as an athlete and trick inventor, then as a connoisseur collector of skis. Today, he is a master ski shaper at Black Crows, providing the means for any trick to be performed.

programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 2: Yorgo Tloupas
programme.desc: In Episode 2, we meet Yorgo Tloupas, the graphic development manager and visual identity creator for Black Crows. Yorgo is a cosmopolitan artist, action-sports aficionado, cigarillo smoker, fixie pedaller, and cylinder head. He wears many hats. Above all, he is a great illuminator of oblong shapes.

programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 3: Minna Riihimaki
programme.desc: In Episode 3, you will encounter a Crow from the early days, Minna Riihimaki. A native of northern Europe. A passionate and lively adventurer. With contagious joy, Minna fed the Black Crows DNA. When she’s not skiing, she’s also a dentist, which is cool.

programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 4: Callum Pettit
programme.desc: In Episode 4, we meet Callum Pettit, a mountain calligrapher, in his Whistler hideout in the heart of British Columbia, Canada.

programme.title: Arc’teryx Presents: Here Goes
programme.desc: Before ‘Skier of the Year’ Sam Kuch drops into any line, he utters the mantra, “here goes.” What began as a superstitious habit has become the confidence booster he uses to face any task. Watch this high-caliber short film about skiing, focus, and execution.

programme.title: Live For This: Float
programme.desc: A film about snowboarders and skiers slashing snow-covered walls, chasing the feeling of weightlessness. We crave those moments when distractions fall away and we lock into mountain life. We dream of it. We study weather forecasts all season. We wake before sunrise. We hit the road in search of it.

programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 5: Jose Lagarellos
programme.desc: In Episode 5, we meet Jose Lagarellos. He is a passionate big mountain skier. He is also the DJ and electronic events organizer behind the Chamonix Unlimited Festival. Like us, he loves original spaces and synthetic sounds. Watch now.

programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 6: Bruno Compagnet & Camille Jaccoux
programme.desc: In Episode 6, we meet Camille Jaccoux and Bruno Compagnet, the founders of Black Crows. In 2000, two pro skiers brought a new ski to life. Their sole aim was to make a ski that could adapt to the needs of big mountain skiing. Today, their products are used on every mountain range around the globe.

programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 7: Hervé Picamelot
programme.desc: For Hervé Picamelot, winter is first and foremost about the road. Each weekend, he leaves his native village in Burgundy and his family’s ancient vines for his second home, Chamonix. A radical life choice, between two vastly different universes and their celestial aromas: skiing and wine.

programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 8: Christina Lustenberger
programme.desc: In Episode 8, we meet Christina Lustenberger. This ex-alpine racer, turned ACMG ski guide possesses all the attributes of a prominent mountain skier: passion, drive and constant wonder. If you enjoy skiing adventures, this episode is not to be missed.

programme.title: Drawn From Here
programme.desc: Drawn From Here is an exploration of professional skier Eric Pollard's processes as an athlete, product designer, and artist. The film follows the influences he draws from and chronicles a pivotal injury Pollard endured during the winter of 2013. Named Powder Magazine's "Movie of the Year.”

programme.title: After The Sky Falls
programme.desc: "After The Sky Falls" captures the skiing of Eric Pollard, Chris Benchetler and Pep Fujas. Two years in the making, this film beautifully documents the Nimbus crew’s approach to skiing, their focus on fun and creativity, and their desire to inspire everyday skiers.

programme.title: Unraveling - Chris Benchetler
programme.desc: Progression means something different to everyone. To Chris Benchetler, progression means evolving as a professional skier, as an artist, and as a father. It means growth, unraveling expectations, and changes over time. It means simplicity, clarity, and freedom. Filmed by director Tyler Hamlet.

programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 9: Kristoffer Turdell
programme.desc: In Episode 9, we encounter skier Kristoffer Turdell, two-time champion of the freeride world. Join us for this special Black Crows documentary about the animal from Gallivare, Sweden. Directed by Nikolai Schirmer.

programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 10: Beau Fredlund
programme.desc: A yurt, 140 inhabitants in town, a door that opens on the northeast of Yellowstone National Park in Montana, a fireplace, a pair of skis, welcome to Beau's wild garden. a film by Nikolai Schirmer

programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 11: The Jackson 9
programme.desc: Jackson Hole, Wyoming is home to some of the most epic skiing in North America. It is also home to a bunch of bohemian skiers nicknamed the Jackson 9. In Episode 11, we kick off Part One of our documentary series dedicated to these hobo shredders and beautiful souls. Directed by Nicolai Schirmer.

programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 12: Nikolai Schirmer
programme.desc: He is tall, handsome, smart, sensitive and on fire while on skis. Nikolai Schirmer, skier, bohemian-movie-maker, reveals himself in this black doc where his meandering path unfolds. An itinerary full of waves and mountains where we discover a man whose heart has progressively tuned in to the rhythm of nature.

programme.title: Snowflake
programme.desc: Witness the joys and wonders of nature through the eyes of Snowflake, an eccentric Swiss skier with a life philosophy just as beautiful and perfectly unique as his namesake.

programme.title: Arc’teryx Presents: Motherload
programme.desc: The hardest part of any adventure is getting out the door. Planning is tedious. Packing is time consuming. Once on-hill, everything falls into place. Follow pro skiers Izzy Lynch and Tessa Treadway as they carry the load of life changing events and the love of their children into the mountains.

programme.title: The Ghost Ski Resorts - Fortress
programme.desc: Deep in the Rockies stands Fortress Mountain. From the late 1960s through the 1980s, this landmark ski area buzzed with activity. Today, it is a quiet thing of abandoned beauty. Skiers Mark Abma and Callum Pettit explore the past and ponder the future of this once iconic Alberta destination.

programme.title: The Ghost Ski Resorts - Ski Rio
programme.desc: In January 2000, Ski Rio closed one night. The resort has remained dormant ever since. It’s no stretch to compare Ski Rio’s snow covered lodgings to the Overlook Hotel in the cult classic thriller The Shining. Just like in the film, the innkeeper Joe Musich admits his job can get a little spooky.

programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 13: The Groomer Crow - Bernie Rosow
programme.desc: Do you despise your office job? If so, Episode 13 offers the truth, the way, and the light. Bernie Rosow could neither consider a life without skiing, nor skiing without the freedom of skiing. Now a snowcat operator, his night shift allows him to solve the equation and to freeski every day, freely.

programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 14: Tony & Deano - Ski Bums Forever
programme.desc: In Episode 14, we honor our friends Tony Stadler and Deano Dacas. Before Black Crows was ever conceived, we were skiing for years with these two. And we will keep on skiing with them, whatever happens. We are the ski bum crows brotherhood forever.

programme.title: The Black Crows - Episode 15: Gabriella Palko
programme.desc: Gabby Palko is living what many skiers would call a dream life. From her sailboat in the Port of Valdez, she is able to ski the Alaskan mountains as often as she likes. In this emotional documentary, she connects the dots between the two parts of her life, broken by the long illness of her father.

programme.title: The Black Crows Presents: Wavy 2
programme.desc: After filming WAVY, director Nikolai Schirmer promised himself that he would never set foot on a ship again. Find out how he ended up off the coast of Svalbard with an excited rookie, a contemptuous captain, and a reformed drug addict, in this thrilling and often comical ski adventure documentary.

programme.title: The Black Crows Presents: La Sentinelle - The Last Frontier
programme.desc: Bruno Compagnet and Camille Jaccoux are friends and co-founders of Black Crows, the iconic ski brand, and La Sentinelle, the renown ski touring event. Two passionate practitioners in conversation, always seeking the wild, beautiful, and natural side of the mountain.

programme.title: Flipside - Resonance - Episode 1 - LAAX
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes with Absinthe Films and the legendary professional snowboarders Nicolas Müller and Wolfgang Nyvelt as they score epic powder at Laax Resort in Switzerland. Nicolas shows the crew around his home terrain, hitting up big hits and dreamy powder fields.

programme.title: Flipside - Resonance - Episode 2 - LAAX
programme.desc: In episode 2 of the Absinthe Films Flipside series, Nicolas Müller and Wolfgang Nyvelt continue exploring Nicolas’ backyard, the Laax Resort in Switzerland. With snow this deep, the mountain is an endless playground.

programme.title: Flipside - Resonance - Episode 3 - LAAX
programme.desc: Snowboarders always have secret stashes. This is especially true for Nicolas Müller. Watch as the Laax local takes Wolle Nyvelt to his favorite spots on the mountain. If you like perfect jumps high above the clouds, powder landings, frontside 1080s, and beautiful sunsets, this episode is for you.

programme.title: Flipside - Resonance - Episode 4 - ARLBERG
programme.desc: In 2012, snowboarder Danny Kass captured his debut part with Absinthe Films. To begin, Kass met up with Eric Jackson in Gigi Rüf’s hometown of Arlberg, Austria. While there, a war broke out between the film crew and the locals. Watch as Gigi steps in to keep the peace.

programme.title: Flipside - Resonance - Episode 5 - ARLBERG
programme.desc: Danny Kass, Gigi Rüf, and Wolle Nyvelt meet up in Arlberg, Austria. The crew spends the day fine-tuning their jump and bagging a perfect bluebird session. Danny puts down his first 720 of the year. Gigi takes a heavy slam trying backside double corks. But wait, there’s more! Drama ensues!

programme.title: Flipside - Resonance - Episode 7 - SAAS FEE
programme.desc: The superhuman Danny Kass and legendary Nicolas Müller reunite with the Absinthe Films crew in Switzerland. From the word “GO!,” the guys score epic powder conditions. Nico goes off slashing. Danny locks down the biggest backflip of his life.

programme.title: Flipside - Resonance - Episode 8 - SAAS FEE
programme.desc: In this episode of Flipside, Danny Kass flips a coin in Saas Fee. Tails he stays in Switzerland. Heads he goes home. Switzerland it is! Now on a solo mission, Kass stacks clips for the cameras of Absinthe Films director Patrick Armbruster. This is Danny Kass at his best.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: Resonance
programme.desc: Resonance stands as a defining Absinthe Films classic, shot across Japan, Switzerland, and Alaska. Featuring Gigi Rüf, Nicolas Müller, Lucas Debari, Danny Kass, Annie Boulanger, Scotty Lago, Bode Merrill, and more in peak form.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Danny Kass - Dose 01
programme.desc: Danny Kass changed snowboarding at a crucial time. Here is how it all began. Starring Danny Kass and the Grenerds.

programme.title: Evo Explores: Kimmy Fasani
programme.desc: Over the course of her career, snowboarder Kimmy Fasani has won the coveted “Women’s Rider of The Year Award” from TransWorld Snowboarding Magazine, and the “Women’s Video Part of The Year Award” from Snowboarder Magazine. This fascinating documentary captures Fasani’s first time riding in Alaska.

programme.title: Evo Explores: Brandon Cocard
